cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: For Stability’s Sake
cards.instruction: Hide a destabilizing truth because you believe the current balance of power must be protected.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Keep the treasurer's page out of the fair briefing. Our chair needs everyone's confidence today. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She spent the stall money on that arch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Call it donated decoration. If the stallholders find out, they'll replace her before we open.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cover the shortfall, but she must sign an IOU.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Privately, after her welcome. Let them see her opening the fair, not borrowing to open it.

mechanism: A directs a fair opening while accepting a private repayment condition so the chair financial truth stays hidden and her authority remains stable.
confusable: Unlike kindness to an embarrassed friend, the stated aim is preventing displacement of the chair; confident management depends on B funding cooperation.
comparison: A shortfall and IOU condition differ from a director resignation and rival department heads.
seedUse: Use D63-b arch/stall money/cover/IOU with S02-b accommodating the needed contributor without exposing the power threat.
